sections.title: IMPORTANT - DELOAD/TRANSITION WEEK
sections.description:
Hi Team,

We’re wrapping up our current training block this week.

Week 4/4 will be what I call a transition week.

What does that mean? After three weeks of rigid, structured progressions, we're going to change things up. We do so in order to balance the rigidity and flexibility that make up a great training program for CrossFit. 
Too much structure and set systems has its limitations, just as too much variance and chaos does.
For us, based on the last 11 years of programming/training/coaching, we've found a 3-week "on" / 1-week "off" routine to be the most effective way to balance out the above.

This transition week looks very different to how we normally build the training programs, so if you are new to the team, please keep that in mind.

There will be less training overall this week to allow for better quality and better recovery, so that you are ready for a new training week starting next Monday.
 
Intensity is self-regulated. If you feel great, push. If you don’t, dial it back.
_______________________
Monday 20th of July we start fresh and continue our progressive overload. I can’t wait to show you what’s coming.
– André Houdet
nst

sections.title: WARM UP
sections.description:
Weightlifting, Warm up 

a. Pulsed stretches
1 round of:
60/60 sec Dynamic Pec Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Lat Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Anterior Hip stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Posterior Hip stretch

b. Activation 
1-2 rounds of:
Mini-band posterior prep routine (20 Alt. Side steps, 20 Good-mornings, 20 Alt. Side steps, 20 Glute bridges)
Banded shoulder routine (ATWYEI x 10 of each)

c. Weightlifting, Snatch specific barbell prep (Empty barbell)
3 sets, rest as needed between sets
2 Snatch Pulls + 2 Muscle Snatches + 2 Power Snatches + 2 Overhead squats
Position: 
Set 1: From High hang (Hips)
Set 2: From Hang (Above knees)
Set 3: From Mid shin

attachments.title: Posterior box hip stretch with reaches
Mini-band deadlift prep (Side step, Goodmorning, Side step, Glute bridge)

sections.title: POWER/SPEED ENDURANCE (Snatch)
sections.description:
Power/Speed Endurance/Hypertrophy, Snatch

a. 5 sets, 1 minute AMRAP / 2 minute Rest
10-8-6-4-2 Power Snatches + Max Overhead squats in the remaining time

Load: (You can round up the numbers so that it makes the plate change simple)
10 reps P. Snatch + Max OHS at: 35% of 1RM Power Snatch (@35%1RM_POWER_SNATCH) 
8 reps P. Snatch + Max OHS at: 45% of 1RM Power Snatch (@45%1RM_POWER_SNATCH) 
6 reps P. Snatch + Max OHS at: 55% of 1RM Power Snatch (@55%1RM_POWER_SNATCH) 
4 reps P. Snatch + Max OHS at: 65% of 1RM Power Snatch (@65%1RM_POWER_SNATCH) 
2 reps P. Snatch + Max OHS at: 75% of 1RM Power Snatch (@75%1RM_POWER_SNATCH)

sections.title: STRENGTH ENDURANCE / HYPERTROPHY (Press)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance/Hypertrophy, Anterior Upper-body (Press)

a. 3 sets, Going every 4th minute:
A "Tough" set of Incline barbell bench press
-Into-
A "Tough" set of (Deficit) Push-ups
-Into-
A "Max" set of Banded tricep extensions (Blue/Red band)
(No rest between exercises.)

A "Tough" set: Stop 2-4 reps before failure.

A "Max" set: Go to failure.

Load: [Barbell Incline press] 45% of your 1RM (regular flat) bench (@45%1RM_BPRESS)

Push up modifications:
[Elite] 20kg plate deficit
[RX] No deficit
[Intermediate] Elevated

Tempo: Controlled descent on all exercises. Quality and control are key.

sections.title: STRENGTH ENDURANCE / HYPERTROPHY (Pull)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance/Hypertrophy, Posterior Upper-body (Pull)

a. 3 sets, Going every 4th minute:
A "Tough" set of Barbell bent over rows
-Into-
A "Tough" set of Supinated ring rows
-Into-
A "Max" set of Double DB hammer curls
(No rest between exercises.)

A "Tough" set: Stop 2-4 reps before failure.

A "Max" set: Go to failure.

Load:
[Barbell bent over rows] Add 10kg  │  25lbs to what you used on the incline press.
[Double DB hammer curl] 2x10-12.5/2x6-8kg │ 2x25-30/2x15-20lbs

Tempo: Controlled descent on all exercises. Quality and control are key.

sections.title: STRENGTH ACCESSORY (Hinge)
sections.description:
Strength Accessory, Posterior Lower-body (Hinge) 

a. 3 sets, 
30/30 sec Single leg Hamstring bridge iso hold
-Into-
10/10 Single leg Dynamic KB Swings
-Rest 2 minutes between sets-

Single leg Hamstring bridge iso hold:
-Elevate your heel on 2x20kg plates / Drop pad / Ballistic block.
-Push heel into the plates. Keep your leg slightly bent. Drive your hips towards the ceiling. 
-Reduce to 20 sec if you can't hold for 30.

Single leg Dynamic KB Swings
-Make sure to practice a few reps on each side with lighter weights to get into the flow here. If you haven't done KB swings in the past, then just stick to a regular KB swing (both feet on the ground) to keep it simple. 
-24-32/16-24kg 
-This is what we call an Iso-Power (contrast) super set.

sections.title: OPTIONAL EXTRA (Core)
sections.description:
Optional Extra, Core

a. 3 sets,
A “Tough” set of Parallette Shoot throughs*
-Rest 60 sec-
A “Tough” Strict Knees to elbows
-Rest 60 sec-

*Two versions based on your level:
Version #1: Touch in front and back.
Version #2 Straight through and back without touching in front.
